overview.description: The Kensington Premium Opportunities ETF (KPO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that combines synthetic US large-cap equity exposure, Treasury collateral, options premiums, and systematic hedging. KPO was launched on Aug 27, 2026 and is issued by Kensington.
